newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower, Ericsson at record high.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower, Ericsson at record high.

text.p: Swedish shares ended somewhat lower in quiet trade on Thursday after a New York fall a day earlier. Heavyweight telecoms group Ericsson supported indices by rising to a record high.
The exchange's general index slipped 0.12 to 2,832.45 percent in turnover of 4.12 billion crowns.
Ericsson jumped four crowns to a record high of 277.5, supported by favourable U.S. trends for technology shares.
"The underlying tone is positive (in Ericsson) after forecasts about strong mobile phone sales," a dealer said, but added it was not possible to draw conclusions from the rise.
Drugs major Astra slipped 1.5 crowns to 342.5 in a correction after going strong for a couple of days.
"I think we will see a downturn in both Astra and Ericsson in coming days," a trader said. "A little break is necessary before the bourse can pick up speed and rise again."
Drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn dropped six crowns to 257.
The interest sensitive bank sector fell one percent on higher bond yields with S-E-Banken down one to 83.
Forestry group AssiDoman dropped five to 215.
